verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented API reference: the Microsoft Graph API overview with its single graph.microsoft.com endpoint, and a reference page for listing user objects. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or explorer, runnable code samples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
